info.name: LIFE API - Phase 59 Local Verification
info.description: Local-only API smoke and API-key verification. Requests are blocked unless baseUrl resolves to localhost or 127.0.0.1. Public documentation and missing/malformed-key checks need no database fixture. A syntactically valid unknown key may query the configured database, as do role checks and valid/scoped/revoked/expired/quota cases: those requests require testDatabaseConfirmed=YES_ISOLATED_TEST_DATABASE after independently confirming the app is connected to a disposable local test database. Never use production or staging credentials.

exec: const configured = pm.variables.get('baseUrl');
let parsed;
try { parsed = new URL(configured); } catch (error) { throw new Error('Set baseUrl to a valid localhost URL.'); }
if (!['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1'].includes(parsed.hostname)) { throw new Error('Safety stop: this collection can only send requests to localhost or 127.0.0.1.'); }
if (parsed.protocol !== 'http:') { throw new Error('Use the local HTTP application URL, for example http://localhost:3000.'); }
pm.test('OpenAPI endpoint returns 200 JSON', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/json'); });
const spec = pm.response.json();

pm.test('OpenAPI advertises developer test and bearer-key security', function () { pm.expect(spec.openapi).to.match(/^3\./); pm.expect(spec.paths).to.have.property('/api/developer/test'); pm.expect(spec.components.securitySchemes).to.have.property('bearerApiKey'); });

pm.test('OpenAPI response contains no credential material', function () { const body = pm.response.text().toLowerCase(); pm.expect(body).not.to.include('life_live_'); pm.expect(body).not.to.include('password='); });
pm.test('Missing key is rejected as 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Missing key has stable error code and no credentials', function () { pm.expect(body.code).to.eql('API_KEY_REQUIRED'); pm.expect(body.secret).to.be.undefined; pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('life_live_'); });
pm.test('Malformed key is rejected as 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Malformed key returns INVALID_API_KEY without echoing input', function () { pm.expect(body.code).to.eql('INVALID_API_KEY'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('malformed'); });

item.name: Developer test - syntactically valid but unknown local key

exec: if (pm.environment.get('testDatabaseConfirmed') !== 'YES_ISOLATED_TEST_DATABASE') { throw new Error('Safety stop: confirm the app database is an isolated disposable test database before testing syntactically valid keys.'); }
pm.test('Unknown key is rejected as 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Unknown key response does not disclose key material', function () { pm.expect(body.code).to.eql('INVALID_API_KEY'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.variables.get('invalidApiKey')); });

item.name: Developer test - valid disposable local key

exec: if (pm.environment.get('testDatabaseConfirmed') !== 'YES_ISOLATED_TEST_DATABASE') { throw new Error('Safety stop: confirm the app database is an isolated disposable test database before testing API keys.'); }
pm.test('Valid local key authenticates', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Valid-key response has quota schema and excludes secret/digest', function () { pm.expect(body.authenticated).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.scopes).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.quota.remaining.key).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.quota.remaining.account).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.secret).to.be.undefined; pm.expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.to.include(pm.variables.get('validApiKey')); });

item.name: Developer test - insufficient-scope disposable local key

exec: if (pm.environment.get('testDatabaseConfirmed') !== 'YES_ISOLATED_TEST_DATABASE') { throw new Error('Safety stop: confirm the app database is an isolated disposable test database before testing API keys.'); }
pm.test('Wrong-scope key is forbidden', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

pm.test('Wrong-scope response identifies authorization failure without credentials', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.variables.get('wrongScopeApiKey')); });

item.name: Developer test - revoked disposable local key

exec: if (pm.environment.get('testDatabaseConfirmed') !== 'YES_ISOLATED_TEST_DATABASE') { throw new Error('Safety stop: confirm the app database is an isolated disposable test database before testing API keys.'); }
pm.test('Revoked key is rejected as 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

pm.test('Revoked key is inactive and not echoed', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('API_KEY_INACTIVE'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.variables.get('revokedApiKey')); });

item.name: Developer test - expired disposable local key

exec: if (pm.environment.get('testDatabaseConfirmed') !== 'YES_ISOLATED_TEST_DATABASE') { throw new Error('Safety stop: confirm the app database is an isolated disposable test database before testing API keys.'); }
pm.test('Expired key is rejected as 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

pm.test('Expired key response is explicit and does not echo the key', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('API_KEY_EXPIRED'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.variables.get('expiredApiKey')); });

item.name: Quota - first request with one-per-minute disposable key

exec: if (pm.environment.get('testDatabaseConfirmed') !== 'YES_ISOLATED_TEST_DATABASE') { throw new Error('Safety stop: quota tests require a confirmed disposable local database.'); }
if (!pm.environment.get('quotaApiKey')) { throw new Error('Set quotaApiKey to a disposable local key limited to one request per minute.'); }
pm.test('First quota request succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Quota response includes remaining request counts', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.quota.remaining.key.minute).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.quota.remaining.account.minute).to.be.a('number'); });
if (pm.environment.get('testDatabaseConfirmed') !== 'YES_ISOLATED_TEST_DATABASE') { throw new Error('Safety stop: quota tests require a confirmed disposable local database.'); }
if (!pm.environment.get('quotaApiKey')) { throw new Error('Set quotaApiKey to a disposable local key limited to one request per minute.'); }
pm.test('Repeated request is rejected with HTTP 429', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(429); });

pm.test('Quota response has stable error code and retry hint', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('QUOTA_EXCEEDED'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Retry-After')).to.exist; });

if (pm.environment.get('testDatabaseConfirmed') !== 'YES_ISOLATED_TEST_DATABASE') { throw new Error('Safety stop: confirm the app database is an isolated disposable test database before checking role access.'); }
pm.test('Unauthenticated key management access is denied', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

pm.test('Unauthorized response does not expose key data', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('UNAUTHENTICATED'); pm.expect(pm.response.text().toLowerCase()).not.to.include('digest'); });

item.name: API key management - developer account isolation

exec: if (pm.environment.get('testDatabaseConfirmed') !== 'YES_ISOLATED_TEST_DATABASE') { throw new Error('Safety stop: role and account isolation tests require a confirmed disposable local database.'); }

if (!pm.environment.get('developerSessionCookie') || !pm.environment.get('developerUserId') || !pm.environment.get('otherAccountId')) { throw new Error('Set disposable local developer-session and account fixture variables.'); }
pm.test('Developer can access own API-key list', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Changing account filter cannot expose another account keys', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.keys).to.be.an('array'); body.keys.forEach(function (key) { pm.expect(key.ownerUserId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('developerUserId')); }); });
if (pm.environment.get('testDatabaseConfirmed') !== 'YES_ISOLATED_TEST_DATABASE') { throw new Error('Safety stop: role tests require a confirmed disposable local database.'); }
if (!pm.environment.get('adminSessionCookie')) { throw new Error('Set a disposable local Admin session cookie.'); }
pm.test('Admin is authorized to read delegated API keys', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Admin response contains no API secret or digest', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.keys).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(pm.response.text().toLowerCase()).not.to.include('digest'); pm.expect(body.secret).to.be.undefined; });

pm.test('Super Admin response contains no API secret or digest', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.keys).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(pm.response.text().toLowerCase()).not.to.include('digest'); pm.expect(body.secret).to.be.undefined; });

item.name: API key management - ordinary user is forbidden

exec: if (pm.environment.get('testDatabaseConfirmed') !== 'YES_ISOLATED_TEST_DATABASE') { throw new Error('Safety stop: role tests require a confirmed disposable local database.'); }
if (!pm.environment.get('viewerSessionCookie')) { throw new Error('Set a disposable local ordinary-user session cookie.'); }
pm.test('Ordinary user is denied API key management', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

pm.test('Forbidden role response is explicit and contains no key data', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('FORBIDDEN'); pm.expect(pm.response.text().toLowerCase()).not.to.include('digest'); });
